page.title: The Shape Study
page.description: A synthetic collection of exercises in shape, space and observation.

blocks.title: A different way to see familiar things.
body: Notice the space between shapes, collect an idea, and make something of your own.

blocks.title: Three ways to begin
blocks.intro: Choose a starting point. Each study uses the same simple materials.

items.title: Observe
items.body: Find a quiet corner and draw the outlines you see.

media.alt: Geometric shapes in a blue and amber composition

items.title: Arrange
items.body: Move a few shapes around the page. Pay attention to what changes.

media.alt: Overlapping triangles with an offset circle

items.title: Reflect
items.body: Keep one arrangement. Write a sentence about why it held your attention.

blocks.title: Make room for a small discovery

items: Arrange them in more than one way.

quote.text: The space around a shape belongs to the composition too.

blocks.title: Keep looking. Keep making.
blocks.body: Start with the materials you already have.
